name: Gearlynx
description:
Gearlynx is an open-source Atari Lynx handheld console emulator written in C++. It provides accurate emulation of the first color handheld video game console developed by Atari.

Features:
- Accurate emulation of the Mikey and Suzy custom processing chips
- Hardware sprite scaling, distortion, and hardware collision simulation
- Realistic 4-channel audio output reproducing Lynx sound synthesis
- Save state management and configurable display orientation for vertical games
- Gamepad and keyboard configuration with responsive input handling
